verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay ships libraries and a relay server, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence shows only an llms.txt index, a default demo and a public test relay. The OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, and nothing shows an interactive reference with runnable examples, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
